title: Supergirl #19
desc:
SUPERGIRL NO MORE?

Kara Zor-El's exposure to gold Kryptonite has left her without superpowers but not without super friends. The recently reborn Matrix and gloriously goth Nightflame get into a fight to prove themselves worthy of the Supergirl mantle, but another of Kara's Super Force might surprise everyone.

Meanwhile, Kara's not just going to sit on the sidelines: She's reenrolling at Stanhope! But will she make it past orientation with Reactron still on the loose?
